paite: Vaihawmte leh thuneite nuai a kitahlut a thumang ding leh thil hoih chiteng sem ding a mansa a om ding in sinsak inla,
heading: Khristian Tatdan Kilawm
english: Remind them to be in subjection to rulers and to authorities, to be obedient, to be ready for every good work,

paite: kuamah gensiatlouhdan ding, vuallemtak a omdan ding, mi tengteng lak a thunuailutna chiteng hihlang a, nunnem ding in amaute theikhe thaksak nawn in.
english: to speak evil of no one, not to be contentious, to be gentle, showing all humility toward all men.

paite: Ei leng nidanglai in mihai, thumang lou, khem a om, utna leh kipahna chiteng sem, gilou leh hazat hat a om, kihhuai leh kihotuahte i hi uhi.
english: For we were also once foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving various lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.

paite: Himahleh Pathian, i hondampa migitdan leh mihing tung a a-itdan ahong kilat lai in,
english: But when the kindness of God our Savior and his love toward mankind appeared,

paite: diktatna a i thilhihte ziak hilou, azahngaihna ziak a pianthakna a sawp in leh Kha Siangthou a thaksakna in eite ahon hondamta hi.
english: not by works of righteousness which we did ourselves, but according to his mercy, he saved us through the washing of regeneration and renewing by the Holy Spirit,

paite: Huai Kha Siangthou, Jesu Khrist i Hondampa ziak in nakpitak in i tung ah asungbota hi.
english: whom he poured out on us richly through Jesus Christ our Savior;

paite: Huchi a ahehpihna a siamtansak a om in, lametna a tangtawn hinna gouluahte i hihtheihna ding in.
english: that being justified by his grace, we might be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.

paite: Hiai thugen adik ahi. Hiai thilte na phut tinten ka hon deih hi, huchi a Pathian gingtasate'n thil hoih hih ding a apilvan theihna ding un; hiaite mihingte a ding in ahoih in aphatuam uhi.
english: This saying is faithful, and concerning these things I desire that you insist confidently, so that those who have believed God may be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable to men;

paite: Himahleh dotna haihuai, khangthu suina, kiselna, dan thu a kilaina nungngatsan in; huaite thil phatuam lou leh bangmah lou ahi.
english: but shun foolish questionings, genealogies, strife, and disputes about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.

paite: Ginna tuam neimi zaw khatvei nihvei hilh nung in deih ke'n.
english: Avoid a factious man after a first and second warning,

paite: Huchibang mi lampial leh gilou ahi chih thei in, amah mah siam louh akitangsak ahi.
english: knowing that such a one is perverted and sinful, being self-condemned.

paite: Artemas hiam, Taikikas hiam, na kiang a ka hon sawl chiang in, Nikopolis ah ka kiang ah hong pai teitei in; hiai mun a phalbi zat ka tum hi.
heading: Thuhilhna Nanungte
english: When I send Artemas to you, or Tychicus, be diligent to come to me to Nicopolis, for I have determined to winter there.

paite: Dansiam, Zenas leh Apollos azinna ua bangkim ataksaplouhna ding un, phatuamngaitak in na panpih un.
english: Send Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey speedily, that nothing may be lacking for them.

paite: I mite'n leng ataksap khawktakte uh asuktuah theihna ding un leh gah lou a a-omlouhna ding un thil hoih hih a kuhkal ding in zil uhen.
english: Let our people also learn to maintain good works to meet necessary needs, that they may not be unfruitful.

paite: Ka kiang a om tengteng in chibai ahon buk uhi. Ginna a kei hon itte chibai hon buksak in. Na vek ua kiang ah hehpihna om hen, Amen.
english: All who are with me greet you. Greet those who love us in faith. Grace be with you all. Amen.
